dedupe_keys.name: emissieregistratie netherlands pollutant release and transfer register emissions data 1990 to 2024

description: The Dutch national emissions registration. The home page says it holds emissions to air and water of the 375 most important polluting substances, from all relevant Dutch sources, that most emissions are calculated by the registration itself while annually reported company emissions are checked, and that emissions are spatially distributed so it is known where they occur. It is a partnership of knowledge institutes including RIVM, CBS, PBL and Wageningen University and Research. The data export page says the 1990 to 2024 series holds national and regional emissions to air and water, is complete and final, and includes provisional national air totals for 2025, with an export module; the data menu also has company reports, top-10 sources, airports, overview tables and maps and graphs. It is free to use online. Coverage is the Netherlands. Caveats: the licence and file formats of the export are not stated on the pages read. For simulation it gives emissions by source, substance and location, to map industrial pressures and exposure around facilities. A related catalogue record is the EU Industrial Emissions Portal.
